title: Genetic diversity and population structure of reindeer using BovineHD BeadChip
author: Veronika Ruslanovna Kharzinova
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.umkeu4w
materials: Genomic DNA was extracted from muscle and tissue samples using Nexttec columns (Nexttec Biotechnology GmbH, Germany) following the manufacturer's instructions. The quality of the extracted DNA was examined by electrophoresis using 1 % agarose gels viewed under ultraviolet light. The concentration of DNA solutions was quantified using a Qubit 3.0 fluorimeter (Thermo Fisher Scientific (formerly Life Technologies), Wilmington, DE, USA). The OD260/OD280 ratio of DNA solutions was determined by NanoDrop-2000 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Wilmington, DE, USA).

Genomic DNA was extracted from muscle and tissue samples using Nexttec columns (Nexttec Biotechnology GmbH, Germany) following the manufacturer's instructions. The quality of the extracted DNA was examined by electrophoresis using 1 % agarose gels viewed under ultraviolet light. The concentration of DNA solutions was quantified using a Qubit 3.0 fluorimeter (Thermo Fisher Scientific (formerly Life Technologies), Wilmington, DE, USA). The OD260/OD280 ratio of DNA solutions was determined by NanoDrop-2000 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Wilmington, DE, USA).

steps.title: Genotype reindeer samples
steps.instruction: Genotype all reindeer individuals using the Illumina BovineHD Genotyping BeadChip (777,962 SNPs) and call genotypes with Illumina GenomeStudio software.

steps.title: Exclude low‑call samples
steps.instruction: Remove any sample whose genotype call rate is below 90 %.

steps.title: Filter SNPs with PLINK
steps.instruction: Apply the following SNP‑level filters using PLINK v1.07:

substeps.instruction: Exclude SNPs with >10 % missing genotypes across all samples.
Exclude SNPs with minor allele frequency <5 % (‑‑maf 0.05).
Exclude SNPs located on sex chromosomes of the UMD 3.1 assembly.
Exclude SNPs with unknown map positions.
Exclude SNPs with linkage‑disequilibrium r² >0.05 using a sliding window of 50 SNPs moving in 5‑SNP increments.
Exclude SNPs deviating from Hardy‑Weinberg equilibrium (p ≤ 1×10⁻⁶).
Retain only SNPs with GC Score ≥0.5 and GT Score ≥0.5 (≥50 %).

steps.title: Record final SNP set
steps.instruction: After filtering, the dataset contains 8 357 SNPs for 135 domestic reindeer and 8 145 SNPs for 61 wild reindeer.

steps.title: Calculate diversity metrics
steps.instruction: In R, use the diveRsity package to compute observed heterozygosity (Ho), unbiased expected heterozygosity (He), inbreeding coefficient (FIS), and rarified allelic richness (Ar) for each population.

steps.title: Estimate pairwise FST
steps.instruction: Estimate pairwise fixation index (FST) values with the R package StAMMP.

steps.title: Build Neighbor‑Net tree
steps.instruction: Create a distance matrix from the pairwise FST values and generate a Neighbor‑Net tree using Splitstree version 4.14.5.

steps.title: Perform MDS and plot
steps.instruction: Run multidimensional scaling (MDS) on the identity‑by‑state distance matrix with PLINK 1.07 using the flags ‑‑cluster and ‑‑mds‑plot 4, then visualize the MDS plot in R with ggplot2.

steps.title: Run STRUCTURE analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct genetic structure analysis using STRUCTURE software version 2.3.4 (default settings unless otherwise specified).

steps.title: Infer splits with TreeMix
steps.instruction: Use TreeMix version 1.13 to infer population splits and gene flow, applying standard errors (‑se) and jackknife blocks of 10 SNPs (‑k 10).

substeps.instruction: Allow up to two migration events; retain models where p < 0.05.
For each migration‑event model, run 100 independent replicates.

steps.title: Visualize TreeMix results
steps.instruction: Plot the TreeMix tree graph and residuals in R.
